# Pinch: Recipe Library

> Pinch is a recipe keeper app that turns TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube cooking videos into written recipes, with ingredients, steps, and a shopping list. It reads the whole video (speech and on-screen text), not just the caption. It runs on iPhone, Android, and in any browser.

Pinch: Recipe Library is the app at pinch-app.io. It isn't related to other apps or sites named Pinch, such as getpinch.io or the Pinch It! Recipe Box app.

## What Pinch does

- Save a recipe from a TikTok, Instagram Reel, or YouTube video: tap Share and pick Pinch, or paste the link.
- Write out the amounts and steps that are only said out loud or shown on screen.
- Save recipes from recipe websites, cookbook page photos, and handwritten recipe cards.
- Build one shopping list from several recipes: same ingredients merge into one line, grouped by aisle, and pantry staples stay off.
- Rank your saved recipes by what's in a photo of your fridge.
- Remix a recipe with AI (healthier, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free), swap an ingredient, scale servings, or translate it.
- Cook mode with step-by-step instructions and timers, next to the source video.
- Flag allergies and disliked ingredients on every recipe.

## Price

- Free: 10 recipe credits every month.
- No subscription. Extra credit packs are one-time purchases: 10 credits for $1.99, 30 for $4.99, 100 for $7.99 (US prices). Bought credits never expire.

## Platforms and languages

- iPhone: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pinch-recipe-library/id6796310453)
- Android: [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pinch.myapp)
- Web: [pinch-app.io/app](https://pinch-app.io/app/). The library syncs across devices with one account.
- The app and this site are in English, Spanish, Hebrew, Russian, and Arabic.
